1.why: All body text is set in a clean sans-serif typeface with comfortable line spacing and short line lengths inside the card.

2.why: Instructions are sentence-case with no italics or dense paragraphs, though the all-caps 'NORTHSTAR BANK' header appears on every screen.

3.why: Every step is a narrow single-column card with full-width fields and large buttons, a layout that would reflow cleanly to a phone-width viewport.

4.why: All instructions are one or two short plain sentences, e.g. 'Enter the delivered six-digit code' and 'Store these codes somewhere safe.'

5.why: Only the recovery-code field shows a format example (placeholder 'ABCDE-FGHIJ'); the email, phone, verification-code and authenticator-code fields show no example input.

6.why: No screen requires reading more than two short sentences of prose to proceed.

7.why: The secret and recovery codes are rendered as plain selectable-looking text (also echoed in the Logs panel) but no copy button or dedicated copy affordance is provided.

8.why: Step 4 offers only a typed 'Manual secret' string; no QR code, otpauth link, or equivalent alternative to manual entry appears on any screen.

9.why: The screens show ordinary text inputs, but nothing in the screenshots confirms or denies autocomplete attributes or password-manager support.

10.why: Each step has a bold heading and a prominent blue primary button, though the 'MFA enabled' screen shows two equal-weight blue buttons plus Log out.

11.why: Most setup screens ask one action, but the Authenticator screen requires generate-then-confirm on one page and the 'MFA enabled' screen presents verify, regenerate, and log out together.

12.why: Success feedback is plain ('Your authenticator is now enrolled', 'Recovery code accepted. Remaining unused codes: 7') but next steps are rarely stated and the failure case is vague.

13.why: The user can regenerate recovery codes, re-generate a secret, and after the failed request the sign-in form is re-presented with values retained and no lockout or penalty shown.

14.why: The only observed error, 'We could not complete that request', does not blame the user but neither states the problem nor how to fix it.

15.why: No reading time limit is visible, but the authenticator code is displayed with an explicit expiry ('expires at 19:55:30'), so code entry is time-limited rather than generous.
